headline: Last Call for Halloween, Then the Holidays Take Over
tagline: Final spooky weeks, a beloved ride gets a reprieve, and Abbott Elementary heads to the park.

lead.title: Holidays at the Disneyland Resort Start Nov 13
lead.body: Returning favorites include "Believe … in Holiday Magic" fireworks, "A Christmas Fantasy Parade" and it's a small world Holiday, plus a new Santa spot at Mickey's Toontown Trolley Barn. The start date was moved up from an earlier announced Nov 18.

events.title: Oogie Boogie Bash
events.body: The after-hours Halloween party at Disney California Adventure debuts "Madame Leota's Swinging Wake – A Haunted Mansion Street Party." Many dates have sold out; check the official calendar for what's left.

events.title: Halloween Time at the Disneyland Resort
events.body: Both parks are decked out for the season, including the "Mickey's Trick and Treat" daytime show.

events.title: Plaza de la Familia
events.body: A Día de los Muertos celebration featuring a Coco-themed street show, live mariachi and a memory wall.

events.title: Haunted Mansion Holiday
events.body: Jack Skellington's Nightmare Before Christmas takeover of the Haunted Mansion runs into the new year.

events.title: World of Color – One
events.body: The fan-favorite World of Color show wraps its limited run before the holiday show takes over.

events.title: Bluey's Best Day Ever!
events.body: A live stage show starring Bluey and Bingo. Showtimes vary, so check the Disneyland app.

events.title: Monsters, Inc. Mike & Sulley to the Rescue!
events.body: The Monstropolis dark ride is staying open longer than planned while construction for the Avatar-themed land is resequenced. No specific closing date has been announced.

events.title: Abbott Elementary Visits Disneyland
events.dates: Episode airing expected December; date TBA
events.body: The cast was spotted filming the show's 100th episode at the park in early October. Plot and air date haven't been announced.

events.title: World of Color – Season of Light
events.body: The holiday edition of World of Color returns to Paradise Bay.

events.title: Chip and Dale's Ornament Trail
events.body: Hunt for hidden ornaments around Downtown Disney District and redeem your map for a keepsake. Start date unconfirmed, so check Disneyland.com.

events.title: Festival of Holidays & Santa
events.body: Six festive food marketplaces and the Sip and Savor Pass return, with a mariachi holiday show on Buena Vista Street. Santa greets at Redwood Creek Challenge Trail.

tip: Halloween Time and Plaza de la Familia are included with park admission; Oogie Boogie Bash needs its own ticket. Get your photos before Halloween décor comes down Nov 1.
caveats: Dates come from Disney press releases and fan sites as of Oct 22, 2026. Always confirm in the Disneyland app.
